name: Tomoe
source:
In order to help her husband who failed in his business, she joined the club thinking it to be a normal part-time job. She still remained an employee even after learning the truth. She debuted at the same time as Neko, and the two are close friends. She is lonely by nature and has a strong sex drive. Her husband, who has returned to work at the company, has moved out on his own. She has been unable to see him for a long time, which made her frustrated. She has a gentle and calm personality.

[From [url=https://miconisomi.xii.jp/io/chara.html]Miconisomi[/url]]
